notes.title: Future plans for Hard Work!
notes.content:
In case you missed the announcement from Matchasoft: 

Exciting news! We're officially adding two more routes to Hard Work, absolutely free! The update will have  routes for Rose and President Hart, and a few other game touch-ups and extras! If you've already ordered the physical copy... don't worry! The new content will be included.

-Matchasoft

Now you're probably wondering what's going on with the physicals of Hard Work. Well, we've decided to delay the release of the physicals to add this new content. You can still secure your preorder for the limited edition physical copies of Hard Work! Save 10% by ordering today, release date is still TBD as the content is still in production. We appreciate all your support of Hard Work and hope you're looking forward to the new content coming soon!

notes.title: New Releases Now Available!
notes.content:
Happy Monday! It's been a busy day today with all these releases, but we hope you're ready for them! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/38e8d15f5049dfd34db64cbe5ddb6f77f32acf86.png
First up is I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 1
This title has been out for a while over on our site and is now available fully uncensored on Steam! We've also recently updated this title to contain NO MOSAICS! Those uncensored assets are to die for huh? (Sorry bad joke, couldn't resist!) It's currently 10% off during launch so we hope you'll check it out! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/4a47290e684969e5f7389a7da1deceb073c8a4a8.png
I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 1
Yuusuke awakens in a world where zombies have overrun civilization, but finds that the zombies don't attack him. How will Yuusuke take advantage of his new situation, and what will he discover? Enjoy this twist on the classic zombie survival genre.
Steam

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/c77903020db465c9ad9b360fa6dd01b173a1b664.png
Our next release is Hikari! Clover Rescue
This is our first third party partner to come to our site! We hope you'll all give them a warm welcome on here and on Denpasoft! This title is also fully uncensored/no mosaics! Save 40% when you grab your copy today! You can follow Toffer Team on Twitter or support them on Patreon!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/6d4bcc89e9516f1755253191e135659bf56e5ec1.jpg
Hikari! Clover Rescue
Take on the role as Keigo, a lazy pilot and bounty hunter and stop The Corporation from taking over the world. Save the world, get the girls. All in a hard day's work.
Steam

Now time for some 18+ Adult Only Content DLCs!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/9de32ea0301aee873edc534af790aaa15e509294.png
Are you ready to play strip the witch? Now you can play Re;Lord 1 with all the erotic scenes directly through Steam! We even have a video on the main game store page showing off the strip battle tactics~
*Please note you must own the base game on Steam to use this DLC. This DLC also contains mosaics over the genitals.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/d1de0282ffedd130a59e115615004a15e3a76438.png
Re;Lord 1 ~The witch of Herfort and stuffed animals~
In a fantasy world where magic exists, the demon realm faced an unprecedented danger. Three "witches of disaster" appeared and invaded the demon country of Saarland. Due to the recent peaceful times, Saarland lacked the skills to protect the territory of Groesen.
Steam (base game)
Adult Only DLC

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/b1b601b25b729483ad6fedb829a7ee5708809a79.png
And for our last 18+ DLC release we have NEKOPARA Vol. 1-3! These DLCs will let you [strike]dote up a cat[/strike], I mean, spend some loving bonding time with your cats. Yes. Loving Nekos.
*Please note you must own the base game on Steam to use these DLCs. These DLCs also contains mosaics over the genitals.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/8cfb49649947dc82166821f4d8f31b288dd0aa6a.png
NEKOPARA Vol. 1
What's NEKOPARA? Why, it's a cat paradise! Kashou Minaduki, the son of a long line of Japanese confection makers moved out to open his own shop "La Soleil" as a patisserie.
Steam (base game)
Adult Only DLC

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/e0b7fae3c2278758fdce2f1cbda942eb0641a605.png
NEKOPARA Vol. 2
Business is booming for La Soleil, the patisserie run by Kashou Minaduki with his two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, his sister Shigure, and the Minaduki family's four catgirl sisters.
Steam (base game)
Adult Only DLC

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/fa16f93255513848b21b9cd10c8bf4cbe7ea7cdd.png
NEKOPARA Vol. 3
Patisserie "La Soleil", run by Kashou Minaduki, is flourishing thanks to the help of two catgirls: Maple, full of pride and a little on the haughty side, and Cinnamon, an impulsive daydreamer.
Steam (base game)

But wait there's one more announcement...

We're bringing Glare1more from Kurenaibook to Denpasoft this Friday! 
Please see our latest blog on Denpasoft for more details~
